programme.title: Without a Trace – Spurlos verschwunden
programme.desc: Der Milliardärssohn und Unternehmer Keith Anderson ist mit seinem Privatflugzeug zu einem angeblichen Kundentermin unterwegs, als die Maschine infolge eines Pilotenfehlers abstürzt.\n\nJack und sein Team machen sich auf die Suche nach ihm und finden heraus, dass Keith zu seinem Vater stets ein gespaltenes Verhältnis hatte. Denn er hatte ihn permanent unter Druck gesetzt und außerdem durch eine Intrige die Existenz eines Konkurrenten zerstört. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Without a Trace – Spurlos verschwunden
programme.desc:
Die ehrgeizige Journalistin Molly Samson hat gerade eine Versetzung vom Boulevard ins Innenpolitik-Ressort hinter sich.

Um einen guten Einstand hinzulegen, veröffentlicht sie eine Story über den Abgeordneten Raymond Walsh, die wenig Wahrheitsgehalt hat.

Kurz darauf verschwindet sie spurlos. Vor ihrem Verschwinden wurde Molly gesehen, als sie äußerst nervös war und sich mit einem mysteriösen Mann traf.

Jack Malone will herausfinden, wer der Mann war. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Without a Trace – Spurlos verschwunden
programme.desc: „Spätes Geständnis“. Shay, der Freund von Agent Malones Tochter Hannah, ist nach New York gezogen. Ihr Vater sollte nichts davon erfahren. Doch als Shay verschwindet, hat Hannah keine Wahl….

programme.title: Without a Trace – Spurlos verschwunden
programme.desc:
Der ehemalige Ölplattform-Taucher Derek hat in Robin und ihrem Sohn Travis eine neue Familie gefunden.

Plötzlich taucht sein alter Freund Edgar auf. Dieser ist einst auf der Ölplattform verunglückt und kann seitdem nicht mehr tauchen. Er will, dass Derek eine Ladung gestohlener Drogen vom Meeresgrund hochholt.

Um Derek zu erpressen, entführen Edgars Hintermänner Robin. Travis wird Zeuge der Entführung und hilft Jack und seinem Team bei der Suche. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Doug feiert seinen 40. Geburtstag, und Carrie ist verwundert, warum er deswegen überhaupt keine Panik hat.

Sie wünscht sich ein besseres Leben und hofft, dass Doug auch etwas an seinem bisherigen Leben ändern möchte. Also spielt er ihr einfach eine Midlife-Crisis vor und bremst sie so in ihren Wünschen.

Aber einen großen Traum hat Doug noch: Er möchte mit einer bestimmten Achterbahn fahren, vor der er vor Jahren weggelaufen ist. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Doug und Carrie treffen sich mit ihren Freunden Deacon und Kelly vor dem Kino. Doch Doug und Kelly möchten einen anderen Film als Carrie und Deacon sehen. Also tauschen sie die Partner.

Was beim Kinofilm beginnt, führt sich weiter fort. Kelly und Doug gehen zusammen essen, ins Kino und Go-Kart fahren, während Carrie und Deacon Galerien besuchen und zu Tanzabenden gehen.

Beide Paare sind sehr glücklich und zufrieden damit, bis Doug und Kelly sich heftig streiten. Arthur versucht währenddessen allen möglichen Leuten gute Ratschläge zu geben. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Die Serien-Komödie rund um das „Mobile Armee ’S’Chirurgie Hospital“.

*M.A.S.H.* spielt in Süd-Korea nahe der Front. Die verwundeten Soldaten werden eingeflogen und im amerikanischen Militärlazarett von einem verrückten Team versorgt.

Die zwei Chirurgen Trapper John und Hawkeye sorgen dabei für jede Menge Chaos. Dabei stehen nicht nur unerlaubte Partys und Liebesgeschichten mit den Schwestern an der Tagesordnung ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Immer wieder geraten auch Sanitäter-Einheiten unter Beschuss.

Letztens erwischte es ein Team des Roten Kreuzes. Da bei dem unglücklichen Anschlag ein Chirurg und weiteres medizinisches Personal ums Leben kamen, wird in allen Einheiten nach Freiwilligen gefragt.

Ohne zu zögern melden sich Hawkeye, Hot Lips und Klinger, obwohl sie genau wissen, dass es sich bei dem Einsatz um ein Himmelfahrtskommando handelt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Ein koreanischer Assistenzarzt bittet Major Frank um Urlaub, damit er bei der Geburt seines Kindes dabei sein kann.

Doch wie immer zeigt sich der Offizier von seiner unmenschlichen Seite und verbietet dem zukünftigen Vater die Reise zu seiner Frau.

Hawkeye und Trapper haben die unmöglichen Entscheidungen ihres Vorgesetzten satt und drehen den Spieß um. Sie organisieren einen Transport, der die schwangere Frau des Kollegen in das Lazarett bringt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Dem M*A*S*H-Team steht ein großer Tag bevor, denn General MacArthur will das Lazarett höchstpersönlich besuchen.

Vor allem Colonel Henry will glänzen und lässt das gesamte Camp umkrempeln. Sogar ein Lied soll eigens für das besondere Ereignis komponiert werden.

Doch es kommt alles ganz anders: General MacArthur fährt einmal quer durch das Lager und verschwindet dann. Die Mitarbeiter sind fassungslos. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Doug will ein gemütliches Wochenende mit Carrie verbringen.

Doch sie wird von ihrer Firma nach Hartford geschickt, um dort bei einem Hausbau für eine arme Familie zu helfen.

Als sie und ihre Kolleginnen dort ankommen, bemerken sie, dass ihre Bosse nicht anwesend sind, und so beschließen sie, ein Ladies-Wochenende mit Feiern und Massagen auf Kosten der Firma daraus zu machen.

Doch in Carries Hotelzimmer wartet Doug als Überraschung auf sie.

Carrie versucht, ihn loszuwerden, und behauptet, sie müsste schrecklich viel arbeiten.

Aber Doug kommt hinter ihr Geheimnis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Der Stammplatz von Doug und seinen Kollegen im „Coopers“ wird von Fahrern der konkurrierenden Lieferfirma Priority Plus besetzt. Beide Parteien hassen sich gegenseitig, und es herrscht schon lange Krieg zwischen ihnen.

Doch dann wird Doug von einem der Fahrer, Jack, aus einer misslichen Lage befreit. Beide verstehen sich gut und entdecken, dass sie viele Gemeinsamkeiten haben.

Doug will jedoch nicht als Verräter gelten und verschweigt alles. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Als den Kindern ein kleiner Hund zuläuft, wollen sie den putzigen Kerl natürlich behalten. Selbstverständlich wissen sie nur zu gut, dass Carl keinen Hund im Haus haben will.

Doch für jede Regel gibt es Ausnahmen – und so kommt es zu einer heißen Diskussion, aus der die Kinder schließlich siegreich hervorgehen.

Wenig später schlägt die Stimmung in der Familie um: Der Hund zerbeißt nämlich so ziemlich alles, was ihm in die Schnauze kommt. Bald sind sich die Winslows wieder einig. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Als Carl einen selbst gefertigten Nachtisch nach altem Rezept serviert, ist die Familie hellauf begeistert.

Rachel bringt einem Restaurantbesitzer ein Törtchen zum Probieren, und auch bei dem Feinschmecker schlägt die Leckerei wie eine Bombe ein. Der Chef bestellt Törtchen für die gesamte Restaurantkette.

Rachel überredet die Familie, die Törtchen übers Wochenende zu backen – 12.000 Stück! Sie schaffen das Unmögliche, und Rachel bringt freudestrahlend den Scheck nach Hause. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Während Walter Notheis im Frühjahr 1983 mit seinem Hit "The Cheater" durch die Lande tourt, beginnt seine Frau Joann ein Verhältnis mit Elektriker Jim Williams. programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.desc: Im Februar 1978 stirbt der 56-jährige Stuart Taylor einen qualvollen Tod. Bei der Autopsie wird eine Arsenvergiftung festgestellt. Seine Frau, die 45-jährige Velma Barfield, hat ihm das Gift über längere Zeit ins Essen gemischt, um seine Lebensversicherung zu kassieren.\n\nMit dem Geld will sie ihre Drogensucht finanzieren. Barfield ist die erste Frau, die nach der Wiedereinführung der Todesstrafe 1976 in North Carolina per Giftspritze hingerichtet wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Im Kopf des Mörders
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2007 verschwindet die dreifache Mutter Paige Birgfeld in Colorado spurlos. Als ihr Doppelleben als Escort-Dame bekannt wird, erweitert das den Kreis der Verdächtigen immens. Obwohl der gewalttätige Mechaniker Lester Jones über Anrufe auf Paiges Mailbox als Hauptverdächtiger identifiziert wird, bleibt ihr Schicksal lange Zeit ungewiss. Erst nach 9 Jahren und 2 Gerichtsprozessen gelingt es, Jones den Mord nachzuweisen und zu verurteilen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Medical Detectives – Geheimnisse der Gerichtsmedizin

programme.title: Open Vuur
programme.desc: Vandaag maken Nick en Kevin het zich gemakkelijk met een 'curanto'. Een culinair avontuur uit Zuid-Amerika. Het gerecht wordt een hele dag langzaam gegaard onder de grond. Terwijl het eten gestaag klaar wordt gestoomd, genieten de mannen van een reeks Waaslandse drankspecialiteiten... Dominique waagt zich ondertussen, op verzoek van Tom, aan de uitdaging om een perfecte briochebroodje te kneden. Hij ontdekt al snel waarom Tom deze taak aan hem heeft gegeven, maar de inspanning loont zeker de moeite. Het resultaat is een heerlijk briochebroodje, belegd met gegrilde coquilles en kaviaar van Belgische bodem. Tom en Dominique storten zich vervolgens op een caveman-style barbecue, waar ze sappige biefstukken recht op het knetterende vuur grillen. programme.title: Peppe's Sicilië

Als hij niet in de keuken staat, vind je hem met zijn voeten in het water. Ook Peppe trekt zijn kaplaarzen aan en gaat met Gerlando op zoek naar mosselen en zee-egels. programme.title: Apero – Dining
programme.desc: Iedereen kan wat culinaire inspiratie gebruiken. Misschien moet je dat klassieke diner even vergeten en je gasten verrassen met een aperitief versie 2.0? Vergeet die keurig gedekte tafel en ga voor een gezellige apero-dining. Jeroen en Andy komen nooit inspiratie tekort. Wat dacht je van een tequila-shot met een kraakverse oester? Of ontdek hoe je een heerlijke gin-tonic maakt zonder alcohol. In de keuken bakt Jeroen een aperitief-worst, frituurt hij Oosterse kroketjes met scampi en er zijn zoete wafeltjes met vijgencompote en kaas. programme.title: Toasted!
programme.desc: 's Morgens eten als een koning. Met deze zin brainwasht elke ouder zijn kind. En terecht: ontbijten ís belangrijk, maar ook plezant en ontspannend en dat laatste zit 'm vooral in het bereiden ervan. Het topduo Dagny Ros Asmundsdottir en Dominique Persoone bewijzen dat met heel hun lijf, al hun verhalen en brouwsels in het nieuwe ontbijt&brunch programma Toasted!. In een gezellige bar koken zij samen voor zowel vroege vogels als uitslapers, die heel luxueus of net super basic hun ochtendmaal willen nuttigen. Dagny Ros en Dominique koken, serveren en verrassen zo de klanten met hun menu. De mix tussen reality en instructional cooking is amusant. Bovendien zorgt de interactie tussen de IJslandse schone en de rock-'n-roll chocolademan voor de nodige spielerei en humor. Dagny Ros staat voor de gezonde keuken terwijl Dominique eerder kiest voor gevaarlijk stevig en dat kan alleen maar inspirerend werken.

programme.desc: Aan boord van een Franse nucleaire onderzeeër heeft een jonge officier het uitzonderlijke talent om de geluiden van vijandige onderzeeërs te identificeren. Als hij een foute inschatting maakt zet hij niet alleen zijn reputatie op het spel, maar ook de levens van de hele bemanning.

programme.title: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan
programme.desc: Vietnam, 18 Augustus, 1966. Onder leiding van Major Harry Smith vechten 108 jonge, onervaren Australiërs op een rubberplantage voor hun leven. Urenlang verdedigen ze zich in de stromende regen en modder tegen overmacht van 2500 Vietnamese Vietcong soldaten..

programme.title: Everly
programme.desc: Everly (Salma Hayek) is klaar met de maffiawereld waar haar voormalige vriend Taiko, een gevaarlijke maffiabaas van de Yakuza, de touwtjes in handen heeft. Wanneer ze besluit om als informant aan de slag te gaan bij de politie, is Taiko woest.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime..

programme.title: NAVIGATING GLOBAL ECONOMIC CHANGE Exclusive with WEF President
programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

Ga dan lekker bij je opa en oma op visite! De jongens doen al jaren wat zij willen en deze keer willen ze dat jij alles geeft wat je in je hebt, simpelweg omdat zij dat ook doen. programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: Pressure's On
programme.sub-title: Weeknight Dishes made in Little Thyme
programme.desc: Who has "thyme" to make dinner after a hectic day? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco inspires with four recipes including a Mushroom Thyme Risotto.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef

programme.desc: Chef-host Natalia Machado loves chicken, and who doesn't? Chicken is enjoyed around the world for good reason; it is versatile and reliably delicious.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: Salad Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Salad is a wonderful addition to any meal, and sometimes even a meal on its own"... today, the talented Chef Craig Wong shares several of his superior salad ideas.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss.

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Onmogelijk! Beroemde Ninja-kunst: Geldstijl Jutsu!
programme.desc: Naruto gidst Kunijiro, een jonge rijke jongen die Tsunade bezoekt, door een dag uit het leven van een ninja.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De jacht op de schat is begonnen!
programme.desc: Naruto, Kiba en Hinata worden op een speciale missie gestuurd: Een schattenjacht. Er is echter een nadeel: als ze niet slagen voor de missie, moeten ze terug naar de Academy. Ze vertrekken vol vertrouwen dat de missie makkelijk zal zijn, maar zijn nog steeds bezorgd dat ze terug moeten naar de academie. Alles gaat zo goed als verwacht, totdat er mysterieuze figuren opduiken. Kunnen Naruto en zijn team het goud vinden, of moeten ze terug naar de Academie met de andere kleine kinderen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Rennen, ontwijken, Zigzaggen! Achtervolgen of achtervolgd worden!
programme.desc: Naruto, Kiba en Hinata moeten terug naar Konoha en voorkomen dat hun kwaadaardige look-a-likes hun dorp ruïneren. De bedriegers denken dat het een makkelijke taak zal zijn, maar wanneer de echte Naruto en Kiba hun zwakte blootleggen, ontdekken ze dat het misschien niet zo makkelijk is.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto ontmoet per ongeluk Jiraiya en eist dat hij hem traint. Jiraiya weigert echter, omdat hij het volgende deel van zijn serie moet afmaken. Naruto wil dolgraag trainen en probeert te helpen, maar zoals gewoonlijk gaat het mis. Naruto en Jiraiya vs de Courier Ninja, wie komt er als winnaar uit de bus.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Ontmoeting! De jongen met de naam van een ster
programme.desc: Ongeveer 200 jaar geleden viel er een ster in het Hidden Star Village. Deze ster zou mystieke krachten bezitten. Het dorp heeft echter weinig ninja's, dus hebben ze de hulp van andere dorpen nodig. Naruto vergezelt Lee, Neji en Tenten op een missie om de ster te beschermen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Het slaapliedje dat je je herinnert
programme.desc: Wanneer de mysterieuze aanvaller wegvliegt met de ster en alleen hun Chakra gebruikt, wordt de Konoha-groep in het stof achtergelaten. Ze zweren de ster terug te winnen, maar dat is niet zo eenvoudig als ze hopen. Ondertussen komt Naruto meer te weten over de geschiedenis van Subaru en Natsuhiboshi.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Verborgen Jutsu! De prijs van Ninja-kunst: Kujaku
programme.desc: Alles lijkt uit te lopen op een eindstrijd, maar wie is de echte vijand achter dit alles.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Kunnen de twee de lang geleden begonnen missie voortzetten en wat zal Subaru denken als hij de waarheid ontdekt.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Subaru ontmoet eindelijk zijn moeder, maar is het te laat voor hen? Kan Naruto Akahoshi verslaan en voorkomen dat de ster weer in zijn handen valt, en welke kant zal het dorp kiezen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De glans van de ster
programme.desc: Nadat Akahoshi heeft geprobeerd Sumaru te executeren, staan Hakato en de rest van de kinderen op om hun dorp te beschermen. Akahoshi ziet dat het dorp zich tegen hem keert en neemt drastische maatregelen om zijn succes te verzekeren. Naruto is de enige die deze bedreiging kan verslaan, maar kan hij dat alleen of krijgt hij hulp van een sterker iemand.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto en Shino krijgen een missie om voor de veiligheid te zorgen tijdens de begrafenis van de familie Kagetsu, maar ze realiseren zich al snel dat de echte missie is om de oudste zoon te helpen bij het uitvoeren van de ongebruikelijke laatste wil en testament van de man.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Open voor zaken! De bladverhuisdienst
programme.desc: Naruto, Hinata en Chouji worden uitgekozen voor een missie om een paar marskramers te beschermen die vluchten voor een oorlog in Greenery Country. Tsunade heeft hen echter meer gegeven dan een simpele bewakingsopdracht, door hen ook verhuizers te maken. De marskramers zijn gewoon eenvoudige mensen, die zelfs nooit geregistreerde burgers in het land zijn geweest. Maar als Naruto ontdekt dat de groep wordt achtervolgd, beseffen de drie ninja's dat er meer aan de hand is dan je op het eerste gezicht zou denken.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Het mysterie van de beoogde handelaars
programme.desc: De groep splitst zich in tweeën in een poging hun mysterieuze aanvallers af te schrikken. Maar als Naruto en Chouji ontdekken dat het plan niet werkt zoals bedoeld, realiseren ze zich al snel dat iemand iets belangrijks verbergt.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto, Chouji en Yurinojou nemen het op tegen Ruiga, die water als wapen gebruikt. Ruiga heeft de kracht om water aan de aarde te onttrekken, waardoor hij een onbeperkte voorraad ninja-wapens heeft. Hoe kunnen ze een tegenstander verslaan die een onbeperkte voorraad water heeft? Zelfs als ze kunnen winnen, kunnen ze dan de tweede ninja, Jiga, verslaan? En wat is het ware motief van de prinses om weg te lopen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De Byakugan ziet de blinde vlek!
programme.desc: Nu Naruto is verslagen, besluit Hinata zich bij het gevecht aan te sluiten. Zal zij de tweede kwaadaardige ninja kunnen verslaan? En hoe zit het met de prinses.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Voorspelling: Dood! Bewolkt met kans op zon!
programme.desc: Het gevecht met de derde en laatste kwaadaardige ninja is begonnen. Hij heeft maar één wens en dat is prinses Haruna doden. Zal Naruto in staat zijn deze nieuwe bedreiging te verslaan en Haruna te redden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: De prinses is zwaarder geworden van de zenuwen en wil dat Ino zich voordoet als de prinses om de eerste ontmoeting met een prins die ze aanbidt bij te wonen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Viva Dojo Uitdaging! De jeugd draait om passie!
programme.desc: Als Naruto terugkeert van een missie ontdekt hij dat Lee een Dojo heeft opgezet en wanhopig op zoek is naar een uitdager. Wanneer Gai ontdekt dat niemand hem heeft uitgedaagd, stapt hij naar voren. Maar een verandering in de plannen op het laatste moment verandert alles, en wanneer een bedrieger zich bij de strijd voegt, ontstaat er chaos...

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De mysterieuze vloek van het spookkasteel
programme.desc: Naruto, Hinata en Kiba worden naar het Land van Honing gestuurd om de vrouw van de Daimyo te zoeken. Daar vinden ze een griezelig kasteel en gaan op zoek naar aanwijzingen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Als Lee zijn controleafspraak met Tsunade mist, wordt Naruto op hem afgestuurd. Ondertussen traint Gai iemand die Yagura heet en heeft besloten dat Lee en Yagura een trainingswedstrijd moeten houden. Kan Lee de nieuwe trainee verslaan nadat hij ongemakkelijk nieuws heeft gehoord tijdens zijn examen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Heetgebakerde confrontatie: Student vs. Sensei
programme.desc: Gai zit gevangen in een fort van oefenpalen. Yagura verschijnt, maar is hij er om te helpen of om te hinderen? Naruto, Neji en Tenten duiken op om te proberen Gai te redden, maar zal het te veel voor hen zijn om alleen aan te kunnen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Crisis: Het verborgen blad 11 verzamelt!
programme.desc: Naruto ontmoet een oude man, een bouwvakker genaamd Gennou. Maar wanneer Gennou de plannen steelt van enkele gebouwen in Konoha, wordt Naruto plotseling onderzocht door de ANBU. Wat is de waarheid achter Gennou en waarom lijkt niemand te weten wat er aan de hand is.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Geeft de Anbu het op? Naruto's herinnering
programme.desc: Om de informatie over Gennou te krijgen die ze nodig hebben, brengen de ANBU Naruto in trance, in de hoop de informatie die ze nodig hebben uit Naruto's geheugen te krijgen. Maar zelfs als ze dit allemaal doen, krijgen ze dan wel de informatie die ze nodig hebben.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto en de anderen zetten hun zoektocht voort naar aanwijzingen die leiden naar Gennou of zijn plan. Tijdens een onderzoek van de Ninja Academy ontdekken ze een verdachte trainingspost die tot een nog engere ontdekking leidt.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Nu de stad Konoha in kaart is gebracht met explosieve tags, moet er een beslissing worden genomen of ze worden verwijderd of dat de hele stad wordt geëvacueerd. Er is echter iets vreemds aan deze tags, kunnen ze ontdekken wat het is? En kunnen ze ze allemaal op tijd verwijderen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Meerdere vallen! Aftellen tot vernietiging
programme.desc: Terwijl Shikamaru probeert uit te zoeken wat Gennou nu weer van plan is, vecht Naruto tegen Gennou in de Great Stone-gezichten. Kan Shikamaru Gennou's volgende stap in het plan stoppen voordat het te laat is? En zal Naruto in staat zijn om de Trap Master te verslaan.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto en Sakura presenteren een speciale recap-aflevering met de top vijf gevechten tot nu toe. Er zijn ook interviews met een aantal van het team, en misschien zelfs een aantal van de vijand.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De beslissing van Kurenai: Squad 8 achtergelaten
programme.desc: Naruto ontmoet een meisje genaamd Yakumo dat een verrassend talent heeft voor vernietiging. Kort daarna neemt Kurenai Yuhi, leider van Team 8, een verrassende beslissing en Naruto is vastbesloten uit te zoeken waarom.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto sluipt 's nachts Yakumo's landhuis binnen en droomt dat Kurenai dreigde Yakumo's vermogens te verzegelen. Hij ontdekt dan dat dit de reden is waarom ze het team verliet, maar Kurenai weigert meer te vertellen. Als Kurenai Yakumo gaat opzoeken, vallen verschillende leden van de Kurama Clan aan.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Eindelijk heeft hij Sasuke ingehaald en Naruto doet er alles aan om hem ervan te weerhouden naar Orochimaru te gaan. Heeft hij genoeg kracht om hem te stoppen of is Sasuke voorgoed verdwenen.

programme.title: Open Vuur
programme.desc: Nieuwkomers Nick en Kevin van Zouterover beginnen de week goed door met fris bier te trakteren aan het West-Vlaamse barbecueduo Tom en Dominique. Die laatsten stoken alvast het vuur voor hun traaggegaarde geit op Mongoolse wijze. Een ietwat avontuurlijke bereiding die wel wat tijd in beslag neemt. Ondertussen bereiden de boys uit Antwerpen de lunch voor: kip in zoutkorst met appelmoes vanop de bbq. Ze verzorgen ook nog een smakelijk vieruurtje van secreto iberico met kaviaar. Tom en Dominique testen ook wat voor vlees ze in de kuip hebben met Nick en Kevin in 'De Open Vuur Games'. De verliezer? Die doet de afwas.

programme.title: De Hofleverancier
programme.desc: Tomaat - In 'De Hofleverancier' keert driesterrenchef Gert De Mangeleer terug naar de basis van zijn keuken: kraakverse groenten, die met liefde gekweekt en verzorgd worden door zijn culinair onderlegde tuinman Bart Praet. Op de boerderij bekijken ze samen welke groente er op dat moment in haar topseizoen is en ter plaatse maakt Gert telkens drie gerechten klaar, die deze groente op een magische manier doen schitteren in haar eenvoud. Op het einde geeft Gert deze toegankelijke gerechten telkens een driesterrentoets door ze op een prachtige wijze te dresseren op het bord, met hier en daar een speciale bloem of een lekker kruid uit de tuin.

programme.title: Vlaanderen kookt
programme.desc: Vlamingen zijn Bourgondiërs. Ze weten dat eten een warm en sociaal gebeuren is.Elk gezin heeft wel een speciaal gerecht waar het trots op is. Een specialiteit die ze maar al te graag delen met vrienden en kennissen. Een recept dat een plaats verdient in een kookboek.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: Alle vrouwen in het leven van Dominique en Tom krijgen een stoer menu voorgeschoteld: een Paloma cocktail, geflambeerde schelpjes, asado van speenvarken én Espresso Martini. De avond eindigt verrassend nog met een rondje paaldansen.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: Caernarfon - In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris "Flamebaster" in de rijke culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Hij ontdekt de vergeten oestercultuur van de Menai Strait, kookt een klassieke Victoriaanse beef & oyster pie, en serveert sappige brisket buns aan de band Doniau Cudd. Ook bezoekt hij een duurzame paddenstoelenboerderij en proeft hij fine dining bij restaurant Sheeps and Leeks. De aflevering eindigt met een visfeest op zijn oude woonwijk, met vers gevangen makreel van lokale vissers.

programme.title: Wild van Wild
programme.desc: Patrijs - In dit programma gaat njam-chef Jan Buytaert op zoek naar het wild dat in de vrije natuur heeft geleefd en gegeten, wat meteen de essentie van 'echt' wild is. Samen met wildexpert Gert Michiels maakt Jan een tocht doorheen het Vlaamse landschap, om telkens één specifiek dier en zijn habitat te ontdekken en er meer over te weten te komen. Na deze introducerende babbel over het dier, gaat Jan ter plaatse aan de slag om in deze prachtige herfstomgeving een lekker en toegankelijk wildgerecht klaar te maken.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Vandaag gaat Timon voor old school vlees dat helemaal weer in is: varkenswangen. Die tovert hij om tot heerlijke pulled pork taco's. Daarna serveert hij pinsa met Arabische toppings zoals spicy lamsgehakt, frisse yoghurt en groene kruiden.

programme.title: De Wereld Op Je Bord
programme.desc: China - Wokken is populair, maar het vraagt behalve een hevig vuur, ook kennis van de zogenaamde woktechniek. Maar hoe doe je dat nu precies? Hanne probeert in deze aflevering van De wereld op je bord het zelf uit . Ze schotelt jullie samen met chefkok Chuck heerlijke garnalen in de wok voor, op z'n Chinees! Met vijfkruidenpoeder.

programme.title: Vietnjam, met Quyên
programme.desc: Halong Bay - In Vietnjam neemt Quyên ons mee door culinair Vietnam.

programme.title: De Zomertafel
programme.desc: Aflevering 1 - Bart Desmidt en Jeroen De Pauw maken zomerse gerechten: Bart: Salade van geitenkaas, perzik, granola, Parmaham en basilicum // Licht gerookte zeebaars met rabarber, yoghurt en boontjes // Gepaneerde kalfskotelet. Jeroen: Gegrilde groenten op de BBQ // Varkensribstuk op de BBQ // Kruidenbrood.

programme.title: Op Hete Kolen
programme.desc: Vandaag maakt barbecuechef Michaël Vrijmoed een gerecht klaar waar iedereen duimen en vingers van aflikt, maar waarvan de meesten ook wel een beetje schrik hebben om het klaar te maken: lamsbout. Onze chef prepareert een heerlijke kruidenolie waarmee hij de sappige bout van boven tot onder inwrijft en die de zuivere smaak van het zachte lamsvlees helemaal ondersteunt. Hierbij rolt chef Michaël courgette rolletjes met geitenkaas en serveert hij een zuiderse couscous. Als hapje voor de gasten staat er een nem op het menu, een soort kleine loempia waarmee je je gasten kan verwennen tijdens het aperitief.

programme.sub-title: A King and His Queen S2 E6
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Funhouse
programme.desc: Nå kjendiser fra hele verden blir invitert til å konkurrere i et online reality-show, oppdager de snart at de konkurrerer for sine bare liv, siden de som blir stemt ut, utsettes for de frykteligste konsekvenser som blir kringkastet over hele verden.

programme.title: Conan The Barbarian
programme.desc: Det som fra først var den kampglade kimmeriske krigerens hevntokt blir snart en storslagen strid mot digre dødsfiender, uhyrlige udyr og ytterst små sjanser, og Conan innser at bare han kan redde Hyborias herlige hjemland fra de onde angrepene til overnaturlige undertrykkere.

programme.title: The Cold Light Of Day
programme.desc: Den unge forretningsmannen Will Shaw er på en lenge etterlengtet ferie med sine foreldre. Men middelhavsidyllen tar en brå slutt når Wills familie forsvinner - knidnappet av agenter på jakt etter en mystisk koffert.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime..

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint - one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning - and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: Pressure's On
programme.sub-title: Weeknight Dishes made in Little Thyme
programme.desc: Who has "thyme" to make dinner after a hectic day? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco inspires with four recipes including a Mushroom Thyme Risotto.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: White Fish Episode with Chef Katie Ardington
programme.desc: Skilled Chef Katie Ardington is excited to introduce her favourite fish, striped sea bass, in this fabulous voyage through the 7 seas of seafood cookery.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: Chicken Episode with Chef Natalia Machado
programme.desc: Chef-host Natalia Machado loves chicken, and who doesn't? Chicken is enjoyed around the world for good reason; it is versatile and reliably delicious.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: Salad Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Salad is a wonderful addition to any meal, and sometimes even a meal on its own"... today, the talented Chef Craig Wong shares several of his superior salad ideas.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss.

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time.

programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
